elements.element: Exit obligations are triggered by either expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added language applies "Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason."
Kubient must provide transition assistance when requested by Customer.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six (6) months after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause guarantees assistance for at least 90 days but does not expressly make it available for a six-month period.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause does not state any rates or payment terms for transition assistance.

elements.element: Vendor must return all Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Kubient must "export and deliver to Customer all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Customer (including Requests)."

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The export and delivery deadline is expressly thirty days after expiry or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Although the clause requires an export, it does not expressly require a standard or machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: The original clause permits either return or destruction of Confidential Information, but neither provision requires deletion of Customer Data after its return.

elements.element: Vendor must certify the post-return deletion of Customer Data.
elements.evidence: No deletion certification obligation is included.

elements.element: Exit obligations are triggered by either expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added language expressly applies upon either expiry or termination for any reason.
Kubient is expressly required to provide transition assistance at Customer's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for ninety (90) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause requires assistance for "at least ninety (90) days" following expiry or termination, which provides the required 90-day period.

elements.element: Vendor must export and deliver Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Kubient must export and deliver to Customer all data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Customer, including Requests.

elements.element: Customer Data must be exported within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly imposes a thirty-day export and delivery deadline.

result.reason: The redline fully implements the fallback through 90 days of requested transition assistance and a Customer Data export within 30 days after expiry or termination. It does not implement the preferred six-month period, then-current rates, standard machine-readable format, post-return deletion, or deletion certification. The changes preserve the surrounding termination terms, but "at least ninety (90) days" lacks an endpoint and potentially creates a broader duration obligation than the stated 90-day fallback, so the redline is not strictly minimal.
